social_media.headline: CME Analysis May Be Affected
social_media.summary: Coronagraph imagery needed for additional CME analysis has not updated as expected. SWPC continues its analysis using the imagery and guidance available.

confidence.label: Status
confidence.detail: Forecast monitoring continues; this data limitation does not change the current hazard assessment.

what_we_know: Coronagraph imagery has not updated as of 0905 UTC Thu May 09 2024.
Confidence in exact arrival timing, duration, and strength may be reduced.
The forecast still supports elevated to significant activity from Friday into Saturday.
The active Space Weather Watch remains in effect.

footer.left: Forecast updates continue using available data.
footer.center: Next Watch update by 2000 UTC Thursday.
